source_placement_notes: s240 rahem_metsukim / variant_ka: the parenthetical (נ״א וּכְרוּב לִכְרוּב וְחַיָּה לְחַיָּה) is printed inline, in small type. It opens the last line of the stanza, right after the line break that follows לִכְרוּב, and comes immediately before לְעֻמַּת כִּסֵּא:. It is not a separate line and it does not follow the colon. The literal fragment text should therefore read …וְחַיָּה לְחַיָּה וּכְרוּב לִכְרוּב (נ״א וּכְרוּב לִכְרוּב וְחַיָּה לְחַיָּה) לְעֻמַּת כִּסֵּא:. Applying the variant to exactly 'וְחַיָּה לְחַיָּה וּכְרוּב לִכְרוּב' (the same two pairs in reverse order) is an editorial alignment. The print places the variant after the phrase but does not mark where its scope begins. Candidate7 has variant_ka as a separate block after the stanza, but that is only how the candidate is grouped, not a claim about line order. The XML j:option output does not need to change.

s248 Ki→Od: עוֹד יִזְכָּר starts in the middle of the line, straight after וְהֵיכָלֶךָ:. There is no paragraph break or indent. Ki Maqdishekha and Od Yizkor are therefore one printed paragraph, continued from s246 (…יִתְקַדַּשׁ שִׁמְךָ יְיָ / אֱלֹהֵינוּ.). The candidate's separate block od_yizkor_lanu is a segmentation choice and must not be encoded as a source paragraph break.
